$Comment: Writes the four Lantern Bomb offers at Old Jack's stall from one file, one per tier, each a child
of ShopEntries/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Offer_Base.json, which names the stall. One row binds
every number that differs for a tier: how many bombs (count), the price in Hallow Sweets (price),
the place on the bombs shelf (order) and how many one player may buy a day (daily; 0 is no daily
limit, so raise or zero it to taste). IdPattern spells each offer's id, which is what a player's
purchase count is filed under, so keep it as it is. The title and the line under it are the
bomb's own name and description, so the stall calls each tier what the item calls itself.
